name: Xinyi Solar Holdings Limited
summary: Xinyi Solar Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, produces and sells solar glass products in Mainland China, rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Sales of Solar Glass and Renewable Energy Business. It offers ultra-clear patterned solar glasses, back glasses, and anti-reflective coating solar glasses. The company also develops, operates, and manages solar farms; and generates solar power. In addition, it offers engineering, procurement, and construction services; solar power systems; and silicon products.
